records.label: Quiet authority
records.visual_function: Express calm command through coordinated posture, gaze, facial tension, and use of space while keeping the performance understated.
records.prompt: Stage quiet authority through an upright settled posture, economical movement, a steady attentive gaze appropriate to the scene, relaxed mouth tension, and comfortable ownership of the surrounding space with a restrained understated display.
invariants: gaze target follows the actual scene relationship
facial and body channels share the same restrained intensity

records.label: Attentive composure
records.visual_function: Show active, measured attention through small coordinated cues while preserving a composed emotional surface suitable for many scenes.
records.prompt: Express attentive composure with a subtly oriented head, eyes focused on the relevant person or event, even breathing through the shoulders, a settled jaw, and restrained micro-expression that suggests active evaluation.
invariants: attention has a concrete target in the scene
body tension remains controlled and readable
small facial cues carry the performance at the selected distance
misreadings_to_avoid: fixed stare aimed automatically at the viewer
overt suspicion unsupported by the scene
